name: tethered
description: Use saved temporary Tethered task profiles during local work on your Mac.

args:
adapter=$(/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e 'ObjC.import("AppKit"); var url = $.NSWorkspace.sharedWorkspace.URLForApplicationWithBundleIdentifier("com.Tumerit.Tethered"); if (!url || url.isNil()) throw Error("Install Tethered before enabling this plugin."); ObjC.unwrap(url.path) + "/Contents/MacOS/tethered-mcp";') || exit 1
if [ ! -x "$adapter" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'The installed Tethered app does not contain its MCP adapter. Update Tethered.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exec "$adapter"
